purpose: Govern how DV research claims are promoted, scoped, superseded, retested, or rejected without converting exploratory observations into architecture facts.
principles: ANEC DOTAL != REPRODUCED != CONTROLLED != HOLDOUT_CONFIRMED != INDEPENDENTLY_REPLICATED
negative and null results are first-class evidence
architecture components require an explicit supported claim
existing providers must be preferred when they provide equivalent effect at lower integration and maintenance cost
historical evidence remains valid for its original scope even when operationally stale

evidence_levels.E0_EXPLORATORY: Single or few exploratory observations. Hypothesis generation only.
evidence_levels.E1_REPRODUCED: Behavior reproduced under the same frozen setup. No comparative causal claim implied.
evidence_levels.E2_CONTROLLED: Frozen baseline and treatment, paired comparison where feasible, independent verification, and complete accounting.
evidence_levels.E3_HOLDOUT_CONFIRMED: Frozen protocol confirmed on unseen holdout tasks without post-hoc tuning.
evidence_levels.E4_INDEPENDENTLY_REPLICATED: Result reproduced by a materially independent implementation, benchmark, team, or external study under compatible scope.

architecture_promotion_rule.exceptions: Only for non-core experimental infrastructure where no architecture claim is made.
mandatory_checks: simpler baseline loses materially within the frozen scope
all routing, context, verification, handoff, retry, coordination, controller, and maintenance overhead relevant to the claim is included
no existing provider or simpler composition supplies equivalent effect at lower total cost
failure and inconclusive runs remain in the record

retest_guidance.price_shift_reference: >=25% relative change is a default review trigger, not a universal scientific threshold
retest_guidance.performance_shift_reference: >=5 percentage-point verified solve-rate change is a default review trigger, not a universal scientific threshold
retest_guidance.rule: A trigger marks the operational recommendation stale; it does not erase historical evidence for the original scope.
